So then let’s plan what to do today.
Any ideas? Let’s just go for a walk around the center of London.
But Dad, the center of London is really big and it’s too much walking.
Let’s do do something else.
Well, how about going to a museum?
London has lots of excellent museums according to this website your Dad is looking at.
Here are some exhibitions.
But museums are boring.
Can’t we do something more fun?
Not all museums are boring.
Have a look at this one, it’s the Video Games Museum.
Oh yes. That sounds interesting.
What kind of video games do they have?
Let’s have a look.
Oh, they have all kinds of video games, including a very early video game from 1958 called Tennis for Two.
Tennis for what?
Tennis for Two.
Oh yes, and there’s another one called Ping Pong from 1972.
I remember that one it’s like table tennis.

That’s so old!
Are there any new games?

Teen Queen 4.

And all my friends have Teen Queen 4!

That’s for next year.
Shall we go then?
Sounds good to me.
Let’s have a look at the opening times.
Oh no, it’s closed on Wednesdays, so we can’t go today.
Oh! Well, it’s not the end of the world.
We can go another day.
Any other ideas?

The Railway Museum.
The Railway Museum?
Yes. That sounds boring.
Maybe not. It’s in an old station and you get to ride on an old train.
Actually that does sound boring.

two hundred fifty dollars per person!

OK then, I guess you’re right.

The Museum of Youth Culture.
Youth culture? That sounds all right.
There’s an exhibition about toy ponies, one of your favourite toys.
You’ve still got your collection of toy ponies, haven’t you?
The My Pony Collection.
Yes, but I don’t play with my ponies very much now.
I’m a bit too old.

I thought you did.

interesting? Oh yeah, those clothes look pretty cool!

What? It’s interesting for all of us.

Oh really? What are they like?
Are they violent?
Violent? Of course not, Mum.
Duh! I said comics for girls, not boys.
So what are they like then?
Well, there are two main kinds of comics for girls.
The first kind’s fantasy.
What kind of fantasy?
Can you give me an example?
OK. I suppose the most popular kind is a superhero comic.

I didn’t know that!

There’s a shop I go to in Electric Road.

Why not a place near our home?
There’s a much better choice there.
I’m not sure I like the idea of you buying comics.
Oh, it’s not what you think.
These are comic books for teenagers.
They’re not violent at all.
They’re about problems teenagers have.
Problems teenagers have?
Like what? Arguing with parents.
I mean, we’re arguing now.
That’s a problem for me.
Ha ha. Very funny.
Look you too.

What did you see, Linda?
I saw an exhibition on best -selling toys from the past.
Oh, That sounds interesting.
What did they have?
Well, one of the things they had was a Cabbage -patched Doll.

That doesn’t sound very exciting.
Ah, but this doll is actually really ugly.
Really? Why would anyone want a doll like that?

People bought the doll because it was ugly.
I really can’t believe that.
How many little girls would want one?

Well, I think it’s because there were many different designs.
Many different designs?
Yes, and this made them very collectible.

I can look after it for a few years so it increases in price.
That’s my girl!
Always thinking ahead.

is like a big rubber ball.

Hello everyone. My name is Sokari Douglas and I’ll be your guide for this section of the museum.
Today I’ll be showing you the exhibition on young inventors, and I hope you enjoy the tour.
It sounds really interesting.
Do you think it will inspire you to try some inventions of your own, Angela?
Not likely! I’m no good at science.
But I don’t think all the inventions are about science.
Let’s have a look at them.
So Our first exhibit is the shoe battery charger.
This was invented by Juan Domingo from the Philippines, and he was only 14 when he invented it.
The inventor walks 5 kilometers to school every day.
I know this seems a lot, but In the countryside in the Philippines, many school children have to do the same.
Anyway, the inventor thought that this is a lot of wasted energy.
Wow. A 5 kilometer walk to school every day.
That’s pretty far.
Would you like to walk that far to school, Angela?
Not likely! I’m not going to waste all that energy!
Well actually, according to the inventor, on average people take 7 ,000 footsteps a day.
That seems a lot.
So how does the shoe work?
Well, there are different stages to the process and let me show you.
Here is the shoe and inside each shoe are two electrical discs.
First, the person wearing the shoe steps on the electrical discs every time they take a footstep.
Second, each footstep generates pressure on the disc.
And Third, this pressure is then converted to electricity.
So how to use door to electricity?
You need a battery and you attach it to the outside of your shoes.
I’ve got a question.
Yes? How much electricity do the shoes generate?
That’s a good question actually.
At the moment, not so much but this is the first model.
The inventor gave an example: of when he played basketball for an hour and a half, off, he managed to generate 15 minutes of battery power for a mobile phone.
That’s not very much!
That’s right. But there is one other application that the inventor has suggested.
This electricity can be used to power a light, and this doesn’t need so much power.
Any other questions?
What do you think, Angela?
Well, I wouldn’t like to do all the walking, but it certainly is useful.
What do you think, Dad?
I think it’s great.
I worry that is not practical and you won’t be able to produce enough electricity.
Surely traditional batteries are better.
OK, let’s move on to our next invention.
Just over here.
Can everybody see?

Jean -Paul had the brilliant idea of using the sense of smell instead of sound to wake people up.
Sorry to interrupt, but what smell did Sean Paul find was the most effective to wake people up?
That’s a good question.
And the answer is peppermint.
Peppermint? Yes, peppermint.
So how does the device work then?
Well, first you place some peppermint tablets inside the alarm clock and then you set the alarm.

But does Does it really work?
Oh yes. And you know that most people hate getting up early in the morning?
Well, the inventor reckons that most people wake up in a good mood.
Really? That sounds good to me.
Mm, Sounds too good to be true to me.
And one more thing.
Apparently you also wake up feeling refreshed.
No. I’m not convinced.
I am. I think it sounds fantastic.
What do you think, Angela?
I think I agree with Dad on this one.

Hello

So who is this movie star?
Well, of course, it’s James Dean.
Even if you don’t know his name or have never seen him in a movie, you still might recognize him.
How? Well, You might see his image in a work of art, such as a painting or a screen print.
He has featured in some of the most famous art of the last century.
Apart from art, you might see a photo of him on someone’s wall, or in a restaurant Stront, obviously a black and white photo as it would have been taken in the 1950s.
Or you might hear his name in the lyrics to a pop song, which would be something about looking like James Dean, or smoking like James Dean, driving a fast car like James Dean, or just being cool like
James Dean. He is one of the most recognisable people of the last century.
But why is he so recognisable?
I mean, Why is James Dean still so famous even today?
Well, one of the things that ensured he would be a legend is that He died so young He died at the age of 24, and so his good looks never faded.
The other reason why his fame continues news today is that He died tragically in a car crash, This, I think, contributes significantly to his continuing fame.
What's even more surprising is that James Dean wasn’t one of those actors who made a lot of films his fame rests on his roles in just three movies.
and I'm going James Dean.

Before he made these three movies, he was involved in acting, but only had small roles and he had to supplement his income with other jobs, such as a stunt tester on a TV game show called Beat the Clock.
And he was actually fired.
Why? It's quite ironic really.
In this TV show, Contestants had to do stunts inside a certain time limit, One of the typical stunts was, like say, contestants had to pick up and carry an egg across a room in 30 seconds

That sort of thing.

to do inside the time limit.

So what's so special about Rebel Without a Cause
Well, For the first time ever, in the movies, Rebel without a cause showed the problems faced by a typical teenager in the 1950s.
So what were These problems that teenagers faced back then?
Well, they were pretty similar to those teenagers face nowadays.
but as I say, what made it special was that these problems had never been shown in movies before.
Before that time, and I know this, sounds crazy now, middle -aged adults; usually had the leading roles.
young people played roles such as sons and daughters of the main characters.
characters. So, why were young people even in movies?

And that was it.
James Dean and his role in Rebel Without a cause changed all of that.

it was in movie industries all over the world that films about teenagers started to be produced.

it’s from the 18th Century but is in almost perfect condition.
